title: Rime Launches Prism Voice AI With 300ms Response Time for AI Agents
summary:
The startup Rime released a speech-to-speech AI model for voice agents that generates each response as text before delivering the audio to the user. This mechanism allows businesses to monitor transcripts and block specific agent replies in real time without pausing the call, enabling agents to perform account lookups or freeze bank cards during live conversations.

Rime says the new model, Prism, features a 300ms response time, which is 4x faster than GPT-Live from OpenAI. Backed by $35M in funding, the company says Prism is the first speech-to-speech model that can be customized through reinforcement learning to outperform other models on intelligence.

selectedTweets.text:
Rime has launched Prism, its new speech-to-speech model for AI voice agents that writes each reply as text before saying it out loud.

Companies can edit the transcript and block anything the agent shouldn't say, while Prism keeps the call going and looks up an account or freezes a card mid-conversation.

Rime says no other speech-to-speech model works this way, which makes Prism a safer fit for banks and other regulated businesses.
